content: To verify whether multi-BERT largely counts on a language independent strategy, we test the model on the languages unseen during pre-training. To make sure the languages have never been seen before, we artificially make unseen languages by permuting the whole vocabulary of existing languages. That is, all the words in the sentences of a specific language are replaced by other words in the same language to form the sentences in the created unseen language. It is assumed that if multi-BERT used to find answers by language independent strategy, then multi-BERT should also do well on unseen languages. Table TABREF14 shows that the performance of multi-BERT drops drastically on the dataset. It implies that multi-BERT might not totally rely on pattern matching when finding answers.
